name: The Inn
description: The only inn in Valdoria, The Crooked Lantern. It smells of wet stone even with the hearth lit. Mera runs it and notes down every meal she charges for; the guest ledger sits on the counter.
newcomerView: A low-ceilinged common room with six tables, the hearth at the back, and a counter with a thick ledger on it. Miners are drinking with no fresh coal dust on their clothes.
